title: Programmer Art: Primitive Pixels
description: Certified crunchy planks and noisy netherrack! Yet ANOTHER Programmer Art resource pack that aims to update the new textures with a classic flavor.
body:
### Programmer Art.. 
we all know know of Programmer Art, aswell as Bedrock Edition's Classic Texture Pack. The original Minecraft textures were discontinued in 2019 in favor for a more clean and shiny artstyle. Most people prefer it to this day, but there are is a small community dedicated to preserving the old artstyle in a _collaborative_ way...

Inspired by _Programmer Art Fix_ and _Justzilla's Classic Pack_, i present to you...

# Programmer Art: Primitive Pixels

Immerse yourself in the world of Modern Minecraft with a primitive twist.. Certified crunchy planks, noisy netherrack, inconsistent consistency, and _much much_ more, all while keeping the familiar look of the Jappa counterparts!

Keep in mind this recourse pack is a HEAVY WORK IN PROGRESS, so some textures may look bad or just unfinished. By the time this releases, there will be quite a lot of blocks still missing the primitive twist, but most common blocks you see in the overworld will already be updated.

START OF DEVELOPMENT: 5/31/26

UPLOAD DATE: 6/25/26

## About

The old textures mean the WORLD to me, and i mean that. I am so passionate about minecraft's old textures and i will continue using them forever. As a result, i started working on a programmer art pack in May of 2026 for personal use only. But as i posted progress updates on Twitter, more and more people wanted the pack. so here i am today, publishing this pack.
